# Private ruling and question ids already present in lib/ and test/.
# Read by the "no lib/ or test/ file gains a private ruling or question id"
# test in test/statifier_examples/private_id_test.exs, which defines the id
# shapes. One line per file and id: the file, the first sixteen hex
# characters of the id's SHA-256 (never the id itself), and how many times
# the file carries it, tab-separated. A new id is refused, not added here; a
# line is lowered or deleted when an id leaves its file.
